note: Conditions inspect the recognized customer speech. Use IF tea IN CUSTOMER SPEECH to test its tokens, then write tea or coffee. No loop is needed yet.
solution:
LISTEN
TAKE UP
IF tea IN CUSTOMER SPEECH
  ITEM tea
ELSE
  ITEM coffee
END
MOVE RIGHT 1
DEPOSIT RIGHT
MOVE LEFT 1
